issues.title: Unrecognized User Authentication Flow
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** user whose EAMS-A credentials have recently changed (e.g., due to a name change),
* **I want to** be guided to the correct action after authenticating but before being forced into registration,
* **so that I can** avoid creating a duplicate account and receive clear instructions on how to resolve my login issue.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1: User with changed credentials is guided to an intermediary page**

* **Given** a user has successfully authenticated with EAMS-A,
* **And** their EAMS-A unique identifier does not match an existing user account in the ORBIT database,
* **When** they are redirected to ORBIT,
* **Then** they **must not** be taken directly to the self-registration page.
* **And** they **must** be presented with a new page titled "Is this your first time here?".
* **And** this page **must** display explanatory text detailing why they have landed here.
* **And** this page **must** present two distinct, clickable options:
  1. "I have a ORBIT account but my name or credentials recently changed."
  2. "This is my first time registering for ORBIT."

**Scenario 2: User selects the "Existing Account / Name Change" option**

* **Given** a user is on the "Is this your first time here?" page,
* **When** they select the "I have a ORBIT account..." option,
* **Then** the page content **must** be replaced with text informing them to contact their supervisor or unit administrator to have their account details updated.
* **And** the self-registration form **must not** be displayed.

**Scenario 3: User selects the "First Time Registration" option**

* **Given** a user is on the "Is this your first time here?" page,
* **When** they select the "This is my first time registering..." option,
* **Then** they **must** be immediately redirected to the standard self-registration page that exists today.

**Scenario 4: Existing, unchanged user logs in successfully (Regression)**

* **Given** a user has successfully authenticated with EAMS-A,
* **And** their EAMS-A unique identifier **does** match an existing user account in the ORBIT database,
* **When** they are redirected to ORBIT,
* **Then** they **must** bypass the new intermediary page entirely.
* **And** they **must** be logged in and directed to their standard ORBIT home page.

issues.title: Lock Identity Fields on Registration Page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** ORBIT Administrator,
* **I want** the First Name, Last Name, and Email fields on the self-registration page to be pre-populated and read-only,
* **so that** I can guarantee that the user's identity in ORBIT matches the authoritative data from the EAMS-A authentication service.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria (Gherkin Format)**

**Scenario 1: New User Arrives at Registration Page**

* **Given** a new user has successfully authenticated with EAMS-A and is directed to the self-registration page,
* **When** the registration form loads,
* **Then** the "First Name", "Last Name", and "Email" fields **must** be populated with the information provided by EAMS-A.
* **And** these three fields **must** be visually distinct to indicate they are not editable (e.g., have a greyed-out background).
* **And** these three fields **must** be disabled, preventing the user from clicking into them or changing their values.

**Scenario 2: User Edits Other Fields**

* **Given** the user is on the self-registration page,
* **When** they interact with the form,
* **Then** they **must still** be able to edit all other fields as required (e.g. Organization, Sub-Organization, Note).

**Scenario 3: User Submits Registration Form**

* **Given** the user has filled out all the required, editable fields on the registration form,
* **When** they click the "Register" button,
* **Then** the values from the disabled "First Name", "Last Name", and "Email" fields **must** be successfully submitted and saved to their new ORBIT profile.

issues.title: Add Cancel Button to Registration Page
issues.description:
#### **User Story**

* **As a** new user on the self-registration page,
* **I want** a "Cancel" button,
* **so that** I can easily return to the previous screen if I have reached this page by mistake or decide not to proceed.

---

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1: Viewing the Registration Page**

* **Given** a user is on the self-registration page,
* **When** the page renders,
* **Then** a "Cancel" button **must** be visible on the form, typically next to the "Register" button.
* **And** the "Cancel" button **must** be visually styled as a secondary action (e.g., different color, outline, or less prominent than the "Register" button).

**Scenario 2: User Clicks the Cancel Button with no input data**

* **Given** a user is on the self-registration page,
* **And** they have not entered data into the form fields,
* **When** they click the "Cancel" button,
* **Then** they **must** be immediately redirected to the "Is this your first time here?" page.
* **And** no data entered into the form **must** be saved or submitted.

**Scenario 3: User Clicks the Cancel Button with input data**

* **Given** a user is on the self-registration page,
* **And** they have entered data into the form fields,
* **When** they click the "Cancel" button,
* **Then** an alert will appear notifying them that they have unsaved changes and asking if they want to proceed
* **And** if they choose not to proceed they **must** be immediately redirected to the "Is this your first time here?" page **and** no data entered into the form **must** be saved or submitted,
* **Or** if they choose to proceed they **must** be returned to the self-registration page and any data they input is intact.

issues.title: Ensure company-issued mobile Number is a Valid SMS Notification Channel
issues.description:
**Description:** This PBI addresses a defect where the "company-issued mobile device" number is not being properly utilized in the SMS notification process. Currently, this leads to users not being counted as recipients, not receiving messages, and inaccurate reporting.
---

#### **User Story**

*   **As a** Notification Manager,
*   **I want** the system to treat both the "company-issued mobile device" and "Notification Information SMS" (aka "Secondary SMS") numbers as valid and distinct SMS delivery targets,
*   **so that** I can reliably reach all employee on all their configured devices and have an accurate, auditable record of every notification sent.

#### **Acceptance Criteria**

**Scenario 1: User has BOTH company-issued and Secondary SMS numbers**

*   **Given** a user has valid numbers in both the "company-issued mobile device" and "Secondary SMS" fields,
*   **When** a notification is sent via SMS to a group/layer/work site/etc containing that user,
*   **Then** the user **must** receive the SMS message at **both** phone numbers.
*   **And** the Sent Notification export **must** list **two separate line items** for that user, one for the company-issued number and one for the Secondary number.

**Scenario 2: User has ONLY the company-issued mobile number**

*   **Given** a user has a valid number *only* in the "company-issued mobile device" field,
*   **When** a notification is sent via SMS to a group/layer/work site/etc containing that user,
*   **Then** the user **must** receive the SMS message at their company-issued mobile device number.
*   **And** the Sent Notification export **must** list one line item for that user, showing the company-issued mobile device number as the destination.

issues.title: BUG: SMS Notifications Not Sent in certain scenarios
issues.description:
Following the release of ORBIT 3.2.7, an issue occurred where:
- **if** a user DOES NOT have a company-issued phone number configured in Work Information section
- **and** the user DOES have an SMS Number configured in the Notification Information section
- **when** a Notification Manager sends a notification to Text Message only
- **then** the user IS NOT seen by the system as a valid recipient even though they have an SMS number in Notification Information

BUT

- **if** a user DOES have a company-issued phone number configured in Work Information section
- **and** the user DOES have an SMS Number configured in the Notification Information section
- **when** a Notification Manager sends a notification to Text Message only
- **then** the user IS seen by the system as a valid recipient and receives the notification only at the SMS number in Notification Information

_See also #1157_
